name: Tax Identification Number (TIN)
note: Seychelles's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: (last updated 30 May 2023) under section 35 of the Revenue Administration Act 2009 any person liable for revenue applies for a TIN, issued only by the Seychelles Revenue Commission (SRC); individuals are taxed only in business, and employees are not issued one; a 9-digit random number meeting a checksum (rule not given, `check` left out). Read as given on application, to anyone liable. No age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Seychelles: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: In accordance with Section 35 of the Revenue Administration Act, 2009 any person liable for revenue has to apply for a TIN. ... The employees are not issued with a TIN. Only SRC has the ability to issue TIN. ... The Tax Identification Number, TIN, is a 9 digit number
